acts: FDA prescribing information published on DailyMed

en.title: dronedarone: 7.3 and 7.3 give different instructions for one patient
en.summary: 7.3 reads “reduce the dose of dabigatran to 75 mg twice daily”. 7.3 reads “should be avoided”. Example: At CrCL exactly 30 mL/min, 7.3 places the patient both in the 30 to 50 band (reduce dabigatran) and in the 15 to 30 band (avoid the combination). The same text is in 2 labels from 2 labelers in the DailyMed release of 29 October 2026.
en.impact: Potential effect on a prescribing decision: medium. Arxo does not say which instruction is correct and gives no dose.
